arguments.value: Coral Gold Resources Ltd. and Intermark Capital Corp. entered into a five-year consulting agreement effective February 1, 2020, under which Intermark Capital Corp. provides management and financial consulting services to Coral Gold Resources Ltd. through its principal, David Wolfin. Coral Gold pays Intermark Capital Corp. $10,000 per month, plus approved expenses and applicable taxes, with possible fee increases approved by the board’s compensation committee. The services include advising on management, financial planning, strategy, property acquisitions, budgeting, reporting compliance, internal controls, and overseeing senior management and field personnel, with David Wolfin also serving as President and CEO and reporting to the board. Either party may terminate the agreement on notice, and Coral Gold must pay a termination amount if it terminates, while a change of control can trigger a larger termination payment if Intermark Capital Corp. ends the agreement. The agreement also requires confidentiality, prohibits solicitation of company employees for one year after termination, assigns work product and intellectual property to Coral Gold, confirms the consultant is an independent contractor, and is governed by the laws of British Columbia.
